title: AR48018: Site Supervision
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

During the Office Training, students are to be exposed to different stages of
construction on the site and to learn how the drawings of design is executed at
the site by preparing a report to facilitate set of working drawings, sketches,
annotated photographs etc. to supplement their observations.

Concepts taught in class

Student Opinion

How to Crack the Paper

Classroom resources

Additional Resources
